### Starting Out Well
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/starting-out-well
Passage: 2 Kings 12:1-2
Points:
- Joash began his reign well and repaired the neglected temple under the godly guidance of Jehoiada the priest.
- His obedience highlights the vital impact faithful family members and spiritual mentors can have on leaders.
- Godly pastors and teachers serve as essential models and instructors for the people of God.
- Beginning well in faith is important, but persevering faithfully to the finish is just as crucial.
- Believers should not grow weary in teaching others, as patient spiritual investment produces meaningful fruit.
